daas-irab:1-8.t: ﴿يس﴾ these letters have no i'rab. ﴿وَالْقُرْآنِ الْحَكِيمِ﴾ the wāw is a preposition of oath, and القرآن is the thing sworn by; the preposition and the thing sworn by are both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أقسم" (I swear). ﴿الْحَكِيمِ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of القرآن. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and both are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ; it, together with what precedes it, is a resumptive (mustaʾnaf) statement. ﴿عَلى صِراطٍ﴾ both attached to a second khabar of إنّ. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ a ṣifa of صراط. ﴿تَنْزِيلَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), a case of annexing the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الرَّحِيمِ﴾ a ṣifa. ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْماً﴾ the lām is the lām of causation, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of causation; قوما is its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿أُنْذِرَ﴾ a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿آباؤُهُمْ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ṣifa of قوما. ﴿فَهُمْ غافِلُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى أَكْثَرِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the oath clause is resumptive. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is for causation, and هم is mubtadaʾ; the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of هم. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ, and نا is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of إنا. ﴿فِي أَعْناقِهِمْ﴾ in the place of the second object of جعلنا. ﴿أَغْلالًا﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعلنا. ﴿فَهِيَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and هي is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿إِلَى الْأَذْقانِ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:13-14.t: ﴿وَاضْرِبْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); ضرب here means جعل (to make), i.e. "make for them". ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَثَلًا﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَصْحابَ﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْقَرْيَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ﴾ a past verb, its fronted object, and its postponed fāʿil, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. The messengers were two men from the companions of ʿĪsā (peace be upon him), whom he sent to that city to guide its people to faith. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time, a badal (substitute) from the first إذ. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَيْهِمُ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُما﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَعَزَّزْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِثالِثٍ﴾ both attached to عززنا. ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ, and نا, assimilated into it, is its noun. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to what comes after them. ﴿مُرْسَلُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:15-19.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), and إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِثْلُنا﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of بشر, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿أَنْزَلَ الرَّحْمنُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿تَكْذِبُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبُّنا﴾ mubtadaʾ, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ, and نا is its noun; the clause stands in place of the two objects of يعلم. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar after them. ﴿لَمُرْسَلُونَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and مرسلون is a khabar, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ both attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿الْبَلاغُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ a ṣifa; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ, and نا is its noun. ﴿تَطَيَّرْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of إنا. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive-governing. ﴿تَنْتَهُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the nūn of emphasis is a particle with no grammatical position; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of an oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer of the oath indicates it. ﴿وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it, and parsed like it. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ the fāʿil of يمسنكم. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ a ṣifa. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿طائِرُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. Augury from birds (taṭayyur) was a custom of the Jāhiliyya: they would send off a bird, and if it went to the right they took it as a good omen, and if it went to the left they took it as a bad omen; Islam has forbidden this custom. ﴿أَإِنْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿ذُكِّرْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); it is the protasis, and its apodosis is omitted. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مُسْرِفُونَ﴾ a ṣifa of قوم, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:9-12.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِ﴾ in the place of the second object of جعلنا. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is a second muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَدًّا﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعلنا. ﴿وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فَأَغْشَيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is causal, and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is causal, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُبْصِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿وَسَواءٌ﴾ a fronted khabar, and ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to it; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; it, together with the hamza, is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being "إنذارك وعدمه سواء" (your warning and its absence are equal); it is parsed as mubtadaʾ, and سواء is khabar. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive particle. ﴿تُنْذِرْهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the hāʾ is its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle. ﴿تُنْذِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ﴾ a past verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَخَشِيَ الرَّحْمنَ﴾ a past verb and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْغَيْبِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَبَشِّرْهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and an imperative verb and its object, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بِمَغْفِرَةٍ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَأَجْرٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿كَرِيمٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ, and نا is its noun. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿نُحْيِ الْمَوْتى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness; الموتى is its object, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the alif because of impossibility; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of نحن, and the clause نحن نحيي is the khabar of إنا. ﴿وَنَكْتُبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَدَّمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَآثارَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to ما. ﴿وَكُلَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned; the implied form is "أحصينا كل شيء أحصيناه" (We have counted everything; We counted it). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَحْصَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿فِي إِمامٍ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ a ṣifa; the meaning is: We have preserved it in the Preserved Tablet.

daas-irab:20-23.t: ﴿وَجاءَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿مِنْ أَقْصَا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَجُلٌ﴾ the fāʿil (agent) of جاء; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يَسْعى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is a ṣifa (adjective) of رجل. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, which is dropped for lightness; it was given a kasra to suit the dropped yāʾ; the munādā is in the position of accusative. ﴿اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿اتَّبِعُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its object. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is "huwa" (he), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is an interrogative particle, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِيَ﴾ both attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿أَعْبُدُ الَّذِي﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فَطَرَنِي﴾ a past verb, and the yāʾ is its object; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to ترجعون. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَأَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُونِهِ آلِهَةً﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb, nominative; آلهة is its object and its fāʿil is latent; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أتخذ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿يُرِدْنِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the dropped yāʾ is its object. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بِضُرٍّ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تُغْنِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the weak letter; the clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined with the fāʾ. ﴿عَنِّي﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿شَفاعَتُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يُنْقِذُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:24-29.t: ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ, and the yāʾ is in the position of accusative as its noun. ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of response. ﴿لَفِي ضَلالٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); [the preposition and its genitive noun are] both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿آمَنْتُ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of إني. ﴿بِرَبِّكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَاسْمَعُونِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the yāʾ, dropped for lightness, is its object; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb with a latent nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ﴾ an imperative verb and its object, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ for calling attention (tanbīh). ﴿لَيْتَ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿قَوْمِي﴾ the noun of ليت, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel that suits [the yāʾ]; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of ليت. ﴿بِما﴾ a relative noun, genitive by the bāʾ, both attached to the verb before them; or it is maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar). ﴿غَفَرَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa. ﴿لِي﴾ both attached to غفر. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ fāʿil, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَجَعَلَنِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its first object. ﴿مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun occur in the place of the second object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿جُنْدٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of جند. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating or redundant. ﴿كُنَّا مُنْزِلِينَ﴾ كان with its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿كانَتْ﴾ كان; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and its noun is omitted; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿صَيْحَةً﴾ the khabar of كانت. ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ a ṣifa. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خامِدُونَ﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿يا حَسْرَةً﴾ حسرة is a munādā (the one addressed) resembling the muḍāf, accusative. ﴿عَلَى الْعِبادِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb of calling. ﴿ما يَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ ما is negating, and an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿مِنْ رَسُولٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and رسول is a noun, genitive in form, nominative in position, as the fāʿil (agent) of يأتي; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كانُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to يستهزئون. ﴿يَسْتَهْزِؤُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿أَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ the hamza is for the interrogation of affirmation (taqrīr), لم is a jussive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿كَمْ﴾ the predicative كم (khabariyya), the fronted object of أهلكنا. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of يروا. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مِنَ الْقُرُونِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ and its noun; the interpreted maṣdar is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from the meaning of كم أهلكنا. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to يرجعون. ﴿لا يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إن is negating. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَمَّا﴾ in the sense of إلا (except). ﴿جَمِيعٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ كل; the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَدَيْنا﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿مُحْضَرُونَ﴾ a second khabar, nominative with the wāw.

daas-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وَآيَةٌ لَهُمُ الْأَرْضُ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle; آية is a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective), and الأرض is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿الْمَيْتَةُ﴾ a ṣifa. ﴿أَحْيَيْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وَأَخْرَجْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أخرجنا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْها﴾ both attached to أخرجنا. ﴿حَبًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَمِنْهُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and منه is [a preposition and its genitive noun,] both attached to يأكلون. ﴿يَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to أحييناها. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعلنا. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مِنْ نَخِيلٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of جنات. ﴿وَأَعْنابٍ﴾ conjoined to نخيل. ﴿وَفَجَّرْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to فجرنا. ﴿مِنَ الْعُيُونِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of the omitted object of فجرنا.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿لِيَأْكُلُوا﴾ the lām is for causation, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām. ﴿مِنْ ثَمَرِهِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأكلوا. ﴿وَما عَمِلَتْهُ﴾ ما is a relative pronoun conjoined to من ثمره, and عملته is a past verb and its object. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negating. ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to an omitted one, its implied form being "يرون هذه النعم ويستمتعون بها فلا يشكرونها" (they see these blessings and enjoy them, yet do they not give thanks for them?).

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَزْواجَ﴾ its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿كُلَّها﴾ tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿تُنْبِتُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الْأَرْضُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to مما. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾ conjoined to the earlier مما. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وَآيَةٌ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; آية is a fronted khabar (predicate); لهم is [a preposition and its genitive noun,] both attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ṣifa (adjective) of آية; الليل is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿نَسْلَخُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ both attached to نسلخ. ﴿النَّهارَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is the إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُظْلِمُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). [Translator's note: the source says so, though إذا of surprise is not normally treated as annexed to the clause after it.]

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَها﴾ الشمس is mubtadaʾ (subject), and تجري is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَها﴾ [the preposition and its genitive noun are] both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري, and لها is attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, the demonstrative; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿تَقْدِيرُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْعَلِيمِ﴾ a second ṣifa; the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. القمر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what is mentioned after it. ﴿قَدَّرْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿مَنازِلَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿عادَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (it). ﴿كَالْعُرْجُونِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الْقَدِيمِ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of العرجون.

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿لَا الشَّمْسُ﴾ لا is negating, and الشمس is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَنْبَغِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَها﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينبغي. ﴿أَنْ تُدْرِكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; أن with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of ينبغي. ﴿الْقَمَرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَا اللَّيْلُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negating, and الليل is mubtadaʾ. ﴿سابِقُ﴾ khabar. ﴿النَّهارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَكُلٌّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي فَلَكٍ﴾ both attached to يسبحون. ﴿يَسْبَحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿وَآيَةٌ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and آية is a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿أَنَّا حَمَلْنا﴾ أنّ and its noun; حملنا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the khabar; أنّ with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي الْفُلْكِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) حملنا. ﴿الْمَشْحُونِ﴾ a ṣifa.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وَخَلَقْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقنا. ﴿مِنْ مِثْلِهِ﴾ in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined to حملنا, so like it, it is in the position of nominative. ﴿ما﴾ a relative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَرْكَبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is conditional. ﴿نَشَأْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu" (We). ﴿نُغْرِقْهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The hāʾ is its object; the clause is the apodosis of a jussive condition, with no grammatical position.
The clause نشأ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿صَرِيخَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُنْقَذُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position, and the clause ينقذون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) رحمة. ﴿وَمَتاعاً﴾ a noun conjoined to رحمة. ﴿إِلى حِينٍ﴾ both attached to متاعا.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle. إذا is adverbial and conditional. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل. ﴿اتَّقُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of قيل. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿أَيْدِيكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما خَلْفَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to the preceding. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿تُرْحَمُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعل.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negating. ﴿تَأْتِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form by من, nominative in position, as the fāʿil (agent) of تأتيهم. ﴿مِنْ آياتِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective). ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿عَنْها﴾ both attached to معرضين. ﴿مُعْرِضِينَ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is adverbial and conditional. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل. ﴿أَنْفِقُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of قيل. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ both attached to أنفقوا. ﴿رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to قال. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنُطْعِمُ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, and نطعم is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu" (we). ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَوْ﴾ conditional. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَطْعَمَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object; the clause is the answer of لو, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source prints «جواب لولا محل لها», evidently «جواب لو لا محل لها» run together.] ﴿إِنْ أَنْتُمْ﴾ إن is a particle of negation, and أنتم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective).

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مَتى﴾ an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿هذَا﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْوَعْدُ﴾ a badal (substitute). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes it indicates it.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿صَيْحَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿تَأْخُذُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; the clause is a second ṣifa of صيحة. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is a pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَخِصِّمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فَلا﴾ a resumptive particle, and لا is negating. ﴿يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the nūn, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿تَوْصِيَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿إِلى أَهْلِهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرجعون. ﴿يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause لا يستطيعون, with no grammatical position, like it.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿وَنُفِخَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (it). ﴿فِي الصُّورِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) نفخ; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْأَجْداثِ﴾ both attached to ينسلون. ﴿إِلى رَبِّهِمْ﴾ also both attached to ينسلون; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَنْسِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يا وَيْلَنا﴾ يا is a vocative particle; ويلنا is a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf. ﴿مَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَعَثَنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ مَرْقَدِنا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) بعثنا. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿ما﴾ khabar; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿وَعَدَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَصَدَقَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; صدق is a past verb. ﴿الْمُرْسَلُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿إِنْ كانَتْ﴾ إن is negating, and a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun latent (mustatir), its implied form being "al-ṣayḥa" (the blast); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿صَيْحَةً﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جَمِيعٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَدَيْنا﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿مُحْضَرُونَ﴾ a second khabar.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿فَالْيَوْمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an adverb of time. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تُظْلَمُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿نَفْسٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَلا تُجْزَوْنَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negating, and a passive imperfect verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تجزون. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the defective verb.

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿إِنَّ أَصْحابَ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿فِي شُغُلٍ﴾ the second khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿فاكِهُونَ﴾ the first khabar of إنّ. The nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:56-56.t: ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَأَزْواجُهُمْ﴾ conjoined to هم. ﴿فِي ظِلالٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَى الْأَرائِكِ﴾ both attached to متكئون. ﴿مُتَّكِؤُنَ﴾ the khabar of هم.

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فاكِهَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَدَّعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of a fronted mubtadaʾ (subject): "هو سلام" (it is peace). [Translator's note: the source says «مقدم» (fronted); the mubtadaʾ هو is evidently meant to be omitted (محذوف).] ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبٍّ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of قولا. ﴿رَحِيمٍ﴾ a ṣifa of رب.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿وَامْتازُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; امتازوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) that is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), and the hāʾ is for calling attention (tanbīh). ﴿الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ a badal (substitute); the clause is also maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, rebuke and reproach, and لم is jussive-governing. ﴿أَعْهَدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anā" (I). ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعهد. ﴿يا بَنِي﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf, accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿آدَمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْ لا﴾ أن is explicative (tafsīriyya); لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَعْبُدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by لا. ﴿الشَّيْطانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to عدو. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the nominal clause gives the reason for the prohibition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿وَأَنِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أن is explicative (mufassira). ﴿اعْبُدُونِي﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined to أن لا تعبدوا, with no grammatical position. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿صِراطٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the clause gives the reason for the command.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَضَلَّ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "huwa" (he). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أضل. ﴿جِبِلًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is the answer of the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لم is jussive-governing. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the wāw is its noun. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا, and the verbal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:63-63.t: ﴿هذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿تُوعَدُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of كنتم.

daas-irab:64-64.t: ﴿اصْلَوْهَا﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) اصلوها. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿تَكْفُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم, and the clause كنتم تكفرون is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:65-65.t:
﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿نَخْتِمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu" (We). ﴿عَلى أَفْواهِهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) نختم. ﴿وَتُكَلِّمُنا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَتَشْهَدُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb. ﴿أَرْجُلُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿بِما﴾ both attached to تكلمنا. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause كانوا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the clause يكسبون is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

daas-irab:66-66.t:
﴿وَلَوْ نَشاءُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, لو is conditional, and نشاء is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "naḥnu" (We). ﴿لَطَمَسْنا﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى أَعْيُنِهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) طمسنا. ﴿فَاسْتَبَقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.
﴿الصِّراطَ﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿فَأَنَّى﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and أنى is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُبْصِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:67-67.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لو is conditional. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "naḥnu" (We); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَمَسَخْناهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَمَا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; ما is negating. ﴿اسْتَطاعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُضِيًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نُعَمِّرْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu" (We). ﴿نُنَكِّسْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and its object; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "naḥnu"; the two clauses of condition and answer are in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الْخَلْقِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ننكسه. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لا is negating. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:69-69.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negating. ﴿عَلَّمْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿الشِّعْرَ﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿يَنْبَغِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is conjoined to علمناه, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينبغي. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ذِكْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿وَقُرْآنٌ﴾ conjoined. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:70-70.t: ﴿لِيُنْذِرَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation, and an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, i.e. "it was sent down to him for warning". ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿حَيًّا﴾ the khabar (predicate) of كان; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَحِقَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to لينذر. ﴿الْقَوْلُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَى الْكافِرِينَ﴾ both attached to يحق.

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and rebuke, and the wāw is a conjunction joining to something omitted, implied as "ألم يتفكروا ولم يروا" (have they not reflected, and have they not seen). ﴿يَرَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنَّا﴾ أنّ and its noun. ﴿خَلَقْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the interpreted maṣdar from أنا and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يروا. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقنا. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَمِلَتْ﴾ a past verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَيْدِينا﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَنْعاماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَها﴾ both attached to مالكون. ﴿مالِكُونَ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:72-72.t: ﴿وَذَلَّلْناها﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذللناها. ﴿فَمِنْها﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of conjunction and of consequence (tafrīʿ), and منها is a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿رَكُوبُهُمْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَمِنْها﴾ both attached to يأكلون. ﴿يَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:73-73.t: ﴿وَلَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لهم is [a preposition and its genitive noun,] both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿فِيها﴾ also both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿مَنافِعُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَمَشارِبُ﴾ conjoined to منافع. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (inkārī), the fāʾ is resumptive, and لا is negating. ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:74-74.t: ﴿وَاتَّخَذُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and اتخذوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) اتخذوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آلِهَةً﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun; the clause gives the reason for the taking. ﴿يُنْصَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:75-75.t: ﴿لا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نَصْرَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl. ﴿جُنْدٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هم; the nominal clause is circumstantial. ﴿مُحْضَرُونَ﴾ a second khabar.

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿فَلا يَحْزُنْكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, لا is jussive-governing, and يحزنك is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and its object; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿قَوْلُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿نَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿ما﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُسِرُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما يُعْلِنُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, the wāw is a conjunction, and لم is jussive-governing. ﴿يَرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿الْإِنْسانُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنَّا﴾ أنّ and its noun. ﴿خَلَقْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of ير. ﴿مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلقناه. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَصِيمٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to لم ير, with no grammatical position. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective).

daas-irab:78-78.t: ﴿وَضَرَبَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ضرب is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَنا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ضرب. ﴿مَثَلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَنَسِيَ﴾ a past verb conjoined to ضرب; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿خَلْقَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb; the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مَنْ يُحْيِ﴾ من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الْعِظامَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَهِيَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَمِيمٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:79-79.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿يُحْيِيهَا﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْشَأَها﴾ a past verb and its object, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ an adverb. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم. ﴿خَلْقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:80-80.t: ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a badal (substitute) from the preceding الذي. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل. ﴿مِنَ الشَّجَرِ﴾ also both attached to جعل. ﴿الْأَخْضَرِ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿ناراً﴾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعل. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and إذا is of surprise (fujāʾiyya). ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ both attached to توقدون. ﴿تُوقِدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:81-81.t: ﴿أَوَلَيْسَ﴾ the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (inkārī), and the wāw is a resumptive particle; ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ its noun. ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿بِقادِرٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and قادر is a noun, genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of ليس. ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative. ﴿يَخْلُقَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) قادر. ﴿مِثْلَهُمْ﴾ its object. ﴿بَلى﴾ a particle of response. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْخَلَّاقُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ a second khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined to what the affirmation conveys.

daas-irab:82-82.t: ﴿إِنَّما﴾ a restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle. ﴿أَمْرُهُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb for the future that carries the sense of condition. ﴿أَرادَ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "huwa" (He); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنْ يَقُولَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; أن with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أمره. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقول. ﴿كُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperative, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "anta" (you); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَيَكُونُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the apodosis of an omitted condition, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:83-83.t: ﴿فَسُبْحانَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose verb is omitted. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِيَدِهِ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَلَكُوتُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ a second muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ترجعون. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.
